correctness.rationale: For every finite nonempty carrier with q arbitrary strict total orders, any nonparameter point either belongs to one of at most 2sm oriented immediate-successor slots or is classified solely by its q-dimensional order gap vector; the latter yields at most (m+1)^q types. Explicit orderwise insertion simultaneously realizes all generic and distinguished neighbor types for every prescribed parameter order, proving sharpness and minimality. In one order, all 4m+1 types are realized iff end gaps contain at least two and interior gaps at least three unmarked points; stars-and-bars yields C(N-3m-1,m)/C(N,m). Logarithmic expansion yields exp(-3c²) at m/sqrt(N)->c and zero above the scale. A direct verifier passed 70 constructed extremizers, 12,715 bounded enumerations, and 74 probability counts; finite checks only corroborate proofs.
